Unknown apps follow the default rule delay.
Unknown apps follow the longest rule delay.
On · Turns off at %1$s. Tap to cancel.

Unknown apps will use the longest rule delay for global changes, including pauses and block removal. This takes effect immediately.

Turning this off later requires the longest delay configured at that time. Currently: %1$s, set by %2$s.

The wait starts when you request to turn it off.
